title: The Lip Flute
desc: You discovered that your lips could make the most wonderfully silly sound, and you were absolutely delighted by it. That little frururu became your proudest performance.
story: It started without any warning. Your lips pressed together, a breath pushed through, and out came the most gloriously wet, buzzing sound you had ever produced. You paused for just a second, as if checking whether that had actually happened, and then you did it again. And again. We were laughing before we even realised it, watching you figure out this ridiculous superpower you had somehow discovered all on your own. You kept going like a tiny musician who had just found their instrument.
